I fixed the bug in `ledger/currency.py`, and all 5 tests now pass.

`to_cents` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Binary floats make `19.99 * 100` come out as 1998.999…, so it returned 1998 instead of 1999. The same truncation caused the `0.29` and `4.35` failures.

It now converts through `Decimal(str(amount))` and rounds half up. I checked only the test suite, not other callers.

Negative amounts round half away from zero, so `-0.005` gives -1 cent.
